sam (BluePeak IT): Hi all — trying to finish the POC. Our SSO TXT check keeps failing from your verifier (timeout). We added `_rbw-verify.bluepeak.com TXT \"rbw=zz9f3\"` at provider (FastDNS). Any quick help?

maya (Sales): Sorry about the friction, Sam. Oscar on SE will triage. Which registrar and did you add at the host or the zone apex?

sam (BluePeak IT): Registered via FastDNS, added under the subdomain `_rbw-verify` not apex. TTL 60. dig +short from our office shows the TXT fine.

oscar (Solutions Eng): Two things to try: 1) run `dig +short TXT _rbw-verify.bluepeak.com @8.8.8.8` and share output, 2) check for any CDN/DNS proxy that strips TXT on queries (some providers do that). If you can temporarily set TTL to 30 and add the same token at `bluepeak.com` apex we can test.

sam (BluePeak IT): `dig +short TXT _rbw-verify.bluepeak.com @8.8.8.8` returns nothing but `@1.1.1.1` returns "rbw=zz9f3". Looks like DNS geo/recursive differences.

oscar (Solutions Eng): OK that explains it — our verifier queries from us-east resolvers which may hit a different Anycast node. Workarounds: add apex TXT and reduce TTL; or we can accept a signed SAML metadata blob from your IdP for POC proof-of-domain (rahul can enable temporary allowance).

rahul (Infra): I can enable signed-metadata acceptance for a 7-day POC window. It requires a signed XML file with entityID matching your domain and cert fingerprint. We'll also log it in the audit trail. Legal approval needed for longer-term.

liam (Account Exec): Pricing note: If you want Dedicated for realistic load testing, we can provide a 21-day evaluation Dedicated cluster at a trial rate. Otherwise hosted POC is fine but won't mimic multi-tenant noisy neighbors.

sam (BluePeak IT): Also: SCIM. We need group->role mapping where groups named `eng-core`, `eng-platform` map to `developer`, and `sec-ops` maps to `admin`. Can SCIM do attribute-based mapping?

oscar (Solutions Eng): Yes — we support name and attribute based mapping. Example config (SCIM server side): ```json
{
  "scim_base": "https://id.bluepeak/scim/v2/",
  "auth": {"type":"bearer","token":"<redacted>"},
  "group_map": [
    {"match":"^eng-.*$","role":"developer"},
    {"match":"^sec-ops$","role":"admin"}
  ]
}
```

nora (Security): For the security questionnaire: 1) NameID — we recommend persistent for stable account linking; 2) Audit logs — hosted default 90 days, enterprise supports custom retention (we can export to S3 for 12+ months); 3) SCIM transport — TLS 1.2+ required; we can support mTLS on Private deployments. Sam, confirm required retention and NameID.

sam (BluePeak IT): Compliance needs 12 months retention and persistent NameID. Also they requested SCIM PATCH support rather than full-sync due to group churn.

oscar (Solutions Eng): PATCH is supported. Note: large-scale PATCH traffic is subject to rate limiting; for POC we can temporarily raise limits. Please confirm expected group sizes and daily operations.

sam (BluePeak IT): Eng groups ~900 users, sec ~80. Daily group churn minimal (~5-10 updates/day).

liam (Account Exec): I'll record the commercial ask: extended log retention (12mo) and temporary Dedicated eval (21 days) if needed. Maya, we'll need amendment for DPA (legalbot will send).

legalbot: Auto-note — DPA addendum required for >90d retention and cross-region log export. I'll generate an addendum and tag both parties.

rahul (Infra): For IdP outage testing: options we support — (A) cached sessions (short TTL) to allow 5-15 minutes of access, (B) configure secondary SAML IdP as hot standby (we support multiple IdPs), (C) emergency service account token flow (audit-only, requires approval). Which one should we demo?

sam (BluePeak IT): Let's demo B (secondary IdP) plus cached sessions. We'll use a secondary Okta tenant. How do we set up fallback?

oscar (Solutions Eng): We'll configure primary and secondary entityIDs in SAML settings and set routing priority. For fallback, our runtime tries primary, then secondary after 5s timeout; cached sessions keep users logged for configured window. I'll draft the SAML metadata template you'll need.

oscar (Solutions Eng): (template snippet) ```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID=\"https://sso.bluepeak.com\">
  <IDPSSODescriptor protocolSupportEnumeration=\"urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:protocol\">
    <KeyDescriptor use=\"signing\">...cert info/fingerprint...</KeyDescriptor>
  </IDPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```

maya (Sales): Next steps: 1) Sam to add apex TXT or send signed metadata, 2) Sam to confirm signer for DPA addendum, 3) SE to bump rate limits for POC and configure SCIM PATCH mapping, 4) Infra to enable signed-metadata allowance for 7d if needed, 5) AE/legal to ship DPA addendum. I'll set a 30-min sync for tomorrow.

sam (BluePeak IT): Thanks — I'll try adding apex TXT now and follow up with dig outputs. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

deploy-bot: POC tenant provisioned: poc-bluepeak-210845: endpoint created, SCIM webhook registered.

oscar (Solutions Eng): Great — will standby for dig + metadata.

maya (Sales): TY everyone :rocket:
